project_type: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 6 single-page app (Hebrew RTL marketing/apply site) with a Firebase backend (Cloud Functions in CommonJS JS, Firestore) deployed to Firebase Hosting. Public apply form writes to Firestore 'applications' and posts to a Make.com webhook.
language: TypeScript (client, strict + verbatimModuleSyntax), CommonJS JavaScript (Cloud Functions, nodejs22).
build_system: Vite 6 with @vitejs/plugin-react. Path alias '@/*' -> 'src/*' declared in tsconfig.app.json (and relied on in Vite config). Client build is 'tsc -b && vite build'. tsc -b walks ONLY tsconfig.app.json (include: ['src']) and tsconfig.node.json (include: ['vite.config.ts']); nothing type-checks tests/. Functions have their own package.json (firebase-functions ^6.3.0, firebase-admin ^13.0.0) and no TS build.
test_framework: Playwright ^1.62.1 (@playwright/test). playwright.config.ts has three projects: desktop, mobile, tablet; testDir ./tests; baseURL https://negev.sb0.tech. Existing specs read const SITE = process.env.SITE_URL || 'https://negev.sb0.tech'. No webServer block. There is NO unit-test framework (vitest/jest); pure-helper unit tests are written as Playwright test() blocks with no page.
test_command: npx playwright test <spec> --project=desktop  (pin --project=desktop so no-page unit specs run once, not thrice)
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build must exit 0 (tsc strict + noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters apply to src/). 2) npm run lint (eslint .) must be clean; react-refresh/only-export-components is 'warn' with allowConstantExport:true (warnings exit 0, but design wants zero warnings so isolate hooks from component files). 3) Routing/login specs: npm run build then npx vite preview --port 4173, then SITE_URL=http://localhost:4173 npx playwright test tests/admin-routing.spec.ts --project=desktop. 4) RBAC/offline/list/detail/status specs: run npm run dev (DEV=true) with VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE=1, then SITE_URL=http://localhost:5173 npx playwright test tests/admin-rbac.spec.ts --project=desktop. 5) Public regression: existing tests/form-submit.spec.ts etc. must still pass. 6) Functions: cd functions && node -c index.js and node -c scripts/bootstrap-admins.js (syntax); require('./index.js') should load (admin init is lazy).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in by build/test. vite build emits dist/ (gitignored, hosting artifact). Playwright writes screenshots under tests/screenshots and results under tests/results (not source). No codegen.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell shell. firebase CLI may or may not be installed/authenticated — do NOT run live firebase deploy or live Firestore queries during verification; use the DEV+flag in-memory fixture path for automated tests. Do NOT require real VITE_FIREBASE_* values for the offline/override specs. Never commit secrets (.env is gitignored; bootstrap uses runtime ADC/service-account creds).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. A global development-hierarchy rule says reusable infra belongs in the sibling zpm package, NOT the project — but this admin panel is application-specific product code (one product's UI, business workflow, RBAC), so it correctly lives in this project; no zpm/sig changes. Keep all changes additive: the public apply flow, functions exports.apply, ApplyWizard.tsx, src/lib/webhook.ts, and src/main.tsx MUST remain byte-for-byte unchanged. firestore.rules public 'applications' create block must be copied verbatim.
key_patterns: Client uses the '@/...' import alias (e.g. import { app } from '@/lib/firebase'; import { HomePage } from '@/pages/HomePage'). firebase.ts currently exports app and auth only. Hebrew RTL UI strings throughout; brand CSS tokens (var(--navy) etc.) are defined globally in src/index.css and usable from any stylesheet without importing. Firestore gender is a CRM code string: '7'=זכר, '0'=נקבה, '1'=אחר, else 'לא צוין'. createdAt is stored as an ISO-8601 string by BOTH writers (ApplyWizard addDoc and functions exports.apply), so orderBy('createdAt','desc') sorts chronologically. Status set: new|contacted|interview|accepted|rejected -> חדש|נוצר קשר|ראיון|התקבל|נדחה. firebase-functions v6 onCall receives a single request object: use request.auth and request.auth.token.role (NOT the old context.auth). Two application writer shapes exist: ApplyWizard writes {name,phone,email,idNum,birthdate,gender,city,background,motivation,createdAt,status}; exports.apply writes {name,phone,email,city,age,background,motivation,createdAt,status} (no idNum/birthdate/gender). So Application type marks idNum?/birthdate?/gender?/age?/background?/motivation? optional.
